note: Lyon County park on the neck between East and West Twin Lakes, with a North and a South campground loop either side of County Road 51; the dump station, showers and playgrounds are in the North loop. Sites on the west side of the North loop look onto West Twin Lake through a thin belt of shoreline trees. --Claude
